model: EASYLAB TCU3 single extract or supply air controller (EM-IP, BACnet IP)
applies_to: TROX EASYLAB TCU3 controllers set up as single extract or supply air controller, fitted with the EM-IP expansion module.
summary: TROX EASYLAB lab and room airflow controllers connect to BACnet IP through the EM-IP expansion module. This is TROX's EDE file for the single extract or supply air controller (order code EC / SC): 135 value objects (71 AV, 49 BV, 15 MV). The module always carries the objects of every application; each application's EDE lists only the ones it fills.
notes: The module holds the objects of all applications; objects outside this application stay unused.
AV 32-79 and BV 31-54 are per-member objects for up to 24 controllers in the room system (Device_ID_n, VolflowAct_n, LocalAlarm_n).
Units come from the EDE unit-code column; airflows are in l/s.

integration.summary: This application takes no mode preset over BACnet; the BMS mainly reads airflow, damper and alarm values. Read MV 3 ModeAct, AV 2 VolflowAct, AV 3 VolTotalExh, BV 1 LocalAlarm.

minimum_points.name: ModeAct
minimum_points.why: Current operating mode of this controller

setup: EM-IP default IP address is 169.254.0.1/16; its DHCP server is off at delivery and is switched on with the Reset push button.
BACnet UDP port defaults to 47808; the module can act as BBMD or foreign device (default Normal).
Default device instance 17493, device name Device17493; both can be changed on the module's web server.
gotchas: If the network interface fails the airflow controller keeps controlling; only data exchange with the BMS stops.
Change the web server's default passwords at commissioning.
